title: Harrington's Fukushima delegation visit

tellings.quote: out we were with there the guy that led the delegation on what happened and and Fukushima did not kill anybody.

plain: After the 2011 disaster at the Fukushima nuclear power plant in Japan, a delegation went to learn what had happened, and the man leading it told them that Fukushima "did not kill anybody." A former US Secretary of Energy named John S. Herrington tells this as someone who was with that delegation, and he uses it to argue that nuclear power is safer than people fear.
